protocol.input: original question only; no title, DOI, gold evidence or source filter

answer_sample.method: first N sorted SHA256(20261009:id), before seeing retrieval outcomes

scope_notes: 93 source papers, not a web-scale index
199 public questions; 95 with all sources obtainable; 104 excluded for source access
JATS XML text adapter; PDF parsing, page coordinates and vision not evaluated
No per-question source hint; original question text preserved
Single-source question answering; multi-paper synthesis not evaluated
First-run fixed MiniLM retrieval and local Qwen3-8B, no tuning on outcomes
Strict choice grading; correct prose with an incorrect final letter remains incorrect
